summary: This room is Loudon's DSP/synthesis-physics belt — Piano String Inharmonicity through Wavetable Space as Torus — spread across Projects/, top-level files, and Cross-Domain Resonances/, so the cross-folder blindness the community lens is built to catch was real: Quantum Synthesizer (Projects/) and Photonic Time Crystals (top-level) each independently claim "this physics is not a metaphor, it IS the synthesis equation" and each independently reaches for Spinoza's monism to say so, with zero link between them. Wallpaper Groups and Photonic Time Crystals are the same discovery twice — one classifies periodic symmetry in space, the other in time (Bloch vs. Floquet) — also unlinked. The room also has a small cluster of genuinely orphaned entries (Quadratic Interpolation in DSP, SMPTE LTC, Slime Mold Delay, control-vocabulary-math, all at 0 inbound per the room file and confirmed on the new-entries list) whose isolation is mostly a bookkeeping gap, not thinness — each already names its missing neighbor in body prose or in the neighbor's own frontmatter, just not both ways. One real fallout from a prior Weave surfaced: Piano String Inharmonicity still `mirrors` a target ([[Octave Equivalence]]) that Shepard Tone Synthesizer's body says was absorbed into it in the 2026-07-06 Weave — a merge that left a stale pointer behind. Reading SCHEMA + SCHEMA — Reference in full before this pass (per this run's instruction) is what caught the non-canonical `parent:` field on control-vocabulary-math, the directionality of the `exemplifies`/`deepens` proposals below, and the Octave-Equivalence ghost fallout — the kind of catch a child instructed only to "propose relations" without the field vocabulary in hand would plausibly miss or get backwards.

typed_relations.label: physics-is-the-instrument
typed_relations.rationale: Both entries make the identical structural claim — that a frontier-physics equation is not analogized to audio synthesis but IS the same operator viewed from a different attribute — and both ground that claim explicitly in Spinoza's monism. Neither links to the other despite living the same argument in different physics.
typed_relations.evidence: Quantum Synthesizer: 'The mathematical substrate of quantum mechanics and the mathematical substrate of resonant synthesis are the same equations viewed from different observational frames... This is Spinoza's monism applied to physics.' Photonic Time Crystals: 'they are the most direct physical realization of the claim that crystals are Bloch in space; time-modulated systems are Floquet in time.'

typed_relations.label: space-periodicity-vs-time-periodicity
typed_relations.rationale: Wallpaper Groups is the complete enumeration of periodic symmetry in space (Bloch/crystallographic restriction, 17 groups). Photonic Time Crystals is exactly the temporal analog — Floquet's theorem playing the role Bloch's plays in space. The two entries name the same theorem-pair from opposite sides and never meet.
typed_relations.evidence: Photonic Time Crystals: 'crystals are Bloch in space; time-modulated systems are Floquet in time.' Wallpaper Groups: 'The crystallographic restriction theorem forbids 5-fold... rotational symmetries in 2D tilings... a periodic lattice can only close through integer lattice translations.'

typed_relations.label: canonical-b-coefficient
typed_relations.rationale: The Curve Is the Material's own frontmatter already names Piano String Inharmonicity 'canonical-instance,' and its function-library table lists the exact B-coefficient formula Piano String Inharmonicity derives, verbatim. The link only runs one direction; Piano String Inharmonicity doesn't point back to the more general principle it instantiates.
typed_relations.evidence: The Curve Is the Material: 'String stiffness (B coefficient): f(n) = n·f0·√(1+B·n²). Parameter: B... Physical range: B ≈ 0.0002 (light guitar string) through B ≈ 0.004 (heavy piano bass string).'

typed_relations.label: the-half-physics-does-determine
typed_relations.rationale: The Metaphor Stretch names the general gap between physics and playability — 'the physics gives you the ratios but not absolute pitch, voice count, decay rate.' The Curve Is the Material is the fully worked-out account of exactly the half physics DOES determine (the curve/ratio family) — it deepens Metaphor Stretch's 'stretch' framework rather than standing apart from it.
typed_relations.evidence: The Metaphor Stretch: 'the source physics gives you ratios and tendencies — but not a playable instrument.' The Curve Is the Material: 'Every physically meaningful inharmonic spectrum is described by a mathematical function of partial number... The function shape and its parameters uniquely identify a physical system.'

typed_relations.label: bend-compresses-inharmonicity
typed_relations.rationale: Portamento's own Multi-Modal Portamento section works through exactly Piano String Inharmonicity's B-coefficient mechanism (string tension rising during a bend/glide compresses partials toward harmonic) without naming the entry, and it directly answers one of Piano String Inharmonicity's open questions.
typed_relations.evidence: Portamento: 'The inharmonicity coefficient B couples the modes... A slider that begins with a bell-like inharmonic character can end with a nearly harmonic character as the modes compress together.'

typed_relations.label: interpolation-quality
typed_relations.rationale: Quadratic Interpolation's own §2 is titled 'Wavetable Synthesis' and argues quadratic is 'the sweet spot' there; Wavetable Synthesis Research's Engineering Essentials independently ranks linear/cubic/windowed-sinc for the same job. Same design question, argued from both sides, unlinked.
typed_relations.evidence: Quadratic Interpolation §2: 'The manifesto: Quadratic is the sweet spot for wavetable synthesis.' Wavetable Synthesis Research: 'Interpolation between frames: linear is minimum viable, cubic (Hermite or 4-point) is better, windowed-sinc (Kaiser window) is highest quality.'

open_question_resolutions.question: Do other boundary-crossing instruments (prepared piano, bowed strings with variable bow pressure) show similar pitch-timbre coupling?
open_question_resolutions.proposed_action: Portamento's Multi-Modal Portamento section works the case directly (tension-driven B compression during a bend/glide); pair with the new connects-to link proposed above so a reader lands on the answer.

open_question_resolutions.question: Could inharmonicity be used as a compositional parameter? Varying B over time to morph between piano-like and pure tones?
open_question_resolutions.proposed_action: Curve Is the Material's Morphing Quality Distinction section answers this precisely ('Morphing B from 0.001 to 0.003 traverses the space of real stiff-string materials continuously'); Wavetable Space as Torus formalizes the same move as B being a holonomy parameter. The new exemplifies link proposed above is the connective tissue.
